title: Scale Smarter This Fall
summary: Ecommerce Growth Webinars; TikTok Shop MCF Savings; Extensiv Acquisition; The Latest Product Updates; Holiday Shipping Surcharges and Marketplace Growth in the News; And More.
body_markdown:
## ******Product updates & release notes highlights******


### **Descartes Sellercloud™ (OMS & IMS):**


- **Struggling to manage Shopify Click & Collect orders with shipping-focused statuses? That confusion is now removed.** Store teams can mark orders as Ready for Pickup and then Picked Up, replacing the need to use Mark as Shipped and giving you clearer workflows, more accurate inventory tracking, and better visibility of pickup orders.
- **Want more control over how your Sellercloud Purchase Orders look?[That flexibility is now available](https://help.sellercloud.com/sellercloud-knowledge-base/purchasing/purchase-orders/word-to-pdf-purchase-orders~7678603779756409824?search_id=7685806201976010542&utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026) .** New Word-to-PDF support lets you design PO templates in Microsoft Word and automatically generate polished PDFs tailored to your branding, business requirements, and vendor needs, helping standardize purchasing communications and reduce manual formatting.


[More Updates](https://sellercloud.com/updates/?utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026)


---


### **Descartes Finale™ (OMS & IMS):**


- **Spending too much time comparing shipping options manually? That process is now faster and easier.** Finale’s new rate shopping experience lets users compare available shipping rates in one place and quickly select the best option, helping streamline fulfilment and reduce shipping costs.
- **Struggling to keep in-store and online inventory aligned?[That process is now easier with Finale’s Clover POS integration](https://www.finaleinventory.com/integrations/clover/?utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026) .** Connect Clover with Finale to centralize inventory visibility, sync sales and stock across channels, and support shared or separate inventory for stores, events, pop-ups, and ecommerce operations.


[More Updates](https://finale.help.descartesservices.com/finale-inventory-knowledge-base/other/feature-release-updates~7584932585559543324?utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026)


---


### **Descartes Peoplevox™ (WMS):**


- **Handling large wholesale or store replenishment orders without unnecessary stock movements?[That process is now more efficient](https://peoplevox.help.descartesservices.com/en/user-s-guides/picking/advanced-action-creation~7394583291916767045?search_id=7683976696237285325&utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026#pick-from-bulk-locations-and-pick-from-pick-locations) .** Peoplevox now supports Pick from Bulk, allowing eligible pick actions to allocate inventory directly from bulk locations before using pick-face stock, helping avoid replenishing stock only to pick it straight back out again.


[More Updates](https://peoplevox.help.descartesservices.com/en/product-news-and-updates/release-notes~7399742922350146309?utm_source=descartes_ecommerce_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=monthly_newsletter_sep_2026)


---


### **Descartes Pacejet™ (LTL Shipping):**


- **Want consistent address validation across parcel and LTL shipments, regardless of carrier? That’s now possible.** Pacejet 26.6 adds a carrier-independent Descartes validation option, helping reduce corrected-address fees, failed deliveries, and service issues. It can be set as the default method, while existing UPS and FedEx options remain available.


More Updates


---


### **Descartes ShipRush™ (Parcel Shipping):**


- **Worried that PayPal orders could arrive in ShipRush with missing customer or order details? That risk has now been addressed.** ShipRush’s PayPal import is more resilient to recent formatting changes, recovering missing fields without overwriting valid data so orders arrive complete and ready to pick, pack, and ship.


More Updates


---


### **Descartes XPS Ship™ (Parcel Shipping):**


- **Struggling to find the right FedEx Hold at Location pickup point? That process is now clearer and more reliable.** XPS Ship now shows location names alongside addresses and recognizes more valid FedEx pickup options, making it faster to choose the right staffed location while reducing selection errors.


---


### **Descartes ForecastMine™ (AI Inventory Forecasting):**


- **Spending hours re-entering supplier order forms across multiple systems? That manual workflow is now automated.** ForecastMine lets you upload an order form once to create product records, generate SKUs and barcodes, build draft Shopify listings, and prepare the purchase order, while Digby learns each supplier’s format for faster repeat processing.
- **Struggling to keep thousands of store-level min/max settings up to date? That maintenance burden is now much lighter.** Ask Digby for the products or locations you need in plain English, then update replenishment levels for the whole group in one action, helping transfers better reflect what each store is actually selling.


---


### **Descartes OzLink™ (ERP-Integrated Parcel & Freight Shipping):**


- **Still rekeying shipments from UPS WorldShip or FedEx Ship Manager into your ERP? That gap is now bridged.** OzLink Remote Shipping works with Pacejet to route shipment data into carrier desktop applications while keeping Pacejet as the system of record, reducing duplicate entry, transcription errors, and disconnected shipping workflows.
- **Finding out about a mis-pick only after the order has shipped? That check can now happen before packing.** OzLink Mobile Warehouse introduces Post-Pick Verification, adding a scan-based checkpoint where a second user validates picked items, catches missing or incorrect products, and creates a clear audit trail before the order moves on.
